note: Commercially a textbook fit: founded his own companies, worked 100+ hour weeks, owns a home gym with sauna and cold plunge, and paid $6,000 by card on the call without a flicker of price resistance. He fails the health half of the criteria. This is not neglected health, it is a managed chronic clinical picture — generalised hypermobility, three surgically replaced cervical discs from a hereditary degenerative condition, prior knee and shoulder surgery and an active course of physiotherapy — and at 6'0" 215 lb wanting 25 lb off and unable to touch his toes, he is closer to rescue than to good-to-great, even though he is nowhere near the stated 50-lb-overweight gym-averse exclusion. Consistent with the pattern already logged in data/icp.json: the ICP screens on money and starting point but has no clinical criterion, and this is the case where that omission carries the most risk.
